5.0.SP2.description: For CIV - a float value indicating the value to which rounding is required. i.e. 10 means round to a multiple of 10 units/shares; 0.5 means round to a multiple of 0.5 units/shares. The default, if RoundingDirection <468> is specified without RoundingModulus <469> , is to round to a whole unit/share.
